CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2846 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 569849cf18f65ef58a45e85036d4e0544d79f1bc. Bus nonce: a416e91192b032739e4dc6e5fca60559. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 569849cf18f65ef58a45e85036d4e0544d79f1bc`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 569849cf18f65ef58a45e85036d4e0544d79f1bc` or `Fix review: blocked 569849cf18f65ef58a45e85036d4e0544d79f1bc <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: a416e91192b032739e4dc6e5fca60559`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `569849cf18f65ef58a45e85036d4e0544d79f1bc` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2846 569849cf18f65ef58a45e85036d4e0544d79f1bc") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2846-a416e911`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
ROUND-2 DELTA REVIEW of #2846 (triage batch 32, dev/programme/triage/s6-batch32.md, rulings P184-P191), head 569849cf18f65ef58a45e85036d4e0544d79f1bc, bus nonce a416e91192b032739e4dc6e5fca60559, against dev/governance/roles/proposal-triage.md, from a detached worktree at the head SHA. Round 1 (origin/review/2846, verdict blocked at 7b271b55103c7569189d7b809724c7a5bf2a27e1) blocked as duplicate-ruling: P189 re-cut P129 (R10-TRAIN-OVERLAP-GRADE carry 9, triage: dev/programme/triage/s6-batch26.md#P129) without citing it and contradicted its null control. Read that verdict first (git show origin/review/2846:VERDICT.md). The triage seat re-cut P189 as "ACCEPT narrowed, amending P129 (carry 9)" in commit 569849cf1 and fixed the stale sentence in the body. The other seven rulings were examined at round 1 and are settled unless the delta touches them; the delta 7b271b55..head is s6-batch32.md only (20 lines changed).

CHECK:
1. The block item: P189 now cites P129 as amended, in the heading or verdict line, and in the carry text says which sentences of carry 9 it replaces. Read P129 in s6-batch26.md and the live carry 9 in dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json at origin/main (R10-TRAIN-OVERLAP-GRADE). The round-1 changes asked for: keep only what P129 does not already hold: (a) Train.skip removes the PR from QUEUE_PENDING, (b) the HOLDER-class same-verdict exception written as a change to P129's null control; drop or mark as counted the s40 #2753 instance P129 already counted; reconcile the log word (ALREADY vs SKIPPED) with P129's "log the same word". Check each is done, and name any that is not.
2. P189 against P129 carry 9: show that the two carries no longer give the fixer two different specs for one predicate in merge_train.py (queue_take, train_add keys on the verdict head). Re-derive at least one instance count in P189 yourself (command beside the figure) at origin/main.
3. The verdict figures in the file/body (ACCEPT, DEFER, REJECT counts) still match the file after the re-cut; python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py pr 2846 prints its line (the orchestrator measured 6 routed of 6 at this head; re-run it); the body's ## Red checks no longer says the diff adds no row (the three-dot diff adds dev/programme/delivery/2846.md; the row is present at this head and reads as a P191 title: say if the row title needs bumping, it is record text and not a block).
4. The three-dot diff against origin/main is only the batch file and dev/programme/delivery/2846.md; no host or home path in the file; CI at the head from the check-runs API (name each red and whether it is this PR's).
Report a ruling you would change, with the evidence, and say merge or blocked.
Output: write verdict.md in a fresh directory of your own. Its first line is exactly "Fix review: merge 569849cf18f65ef58a45e85036d4e0544d79f1bc" or "Fix review: blocked 569849cf18f65ef58a45e85036d4e0544d79f1bc <class>: <reason>" (no brackets; class lower-case letters and dashes). Then a blank line, then "bus-nonce: a416e91192b032739e4dc6e5fca60559". Then the body in sections: a blocked verdict's block under "## Block"; each finding this PR does not settle is its own bullet under "## Findings" ending in "Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>". Everything else under "## Evidence", with files under ev/, one holding the full 40-hex head. Return the verdict on a probe ref: the commit is built with a private index as the role file gives, then pushed to refs/heads/probe/rev-2846-a416e911. Do NOT run bus.sh. Do not post comments, approve or merge. Re-read the head with git ls-remote before writing the verdict. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit or comment. No host or home paths in anything you push; cite repo-relative paths only.
